transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been struggling with a really deep, heavy depression and just constant sadness for about two years now. It feels like I'm constantly carrying this dark cloud, and I just can't seem to shake it off anymore.

During these past two years, have there been any periods of a few months or longer where your mood improved significantly and you felt like your usual self, or has this low mood been present almost every single day?

No, there haven't been any breaks at all. This heavy, sad mood has been there almost every single day for the entire two years. I honestly can't remember a single time during this whole period where I felt like my usual self or experienced any real improvement.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports a continuous low mood lasting for two years without any symptom-free intervals of two months or longer. This clinical presentation meets the duration and persistence criteria for Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia), making it a more accurate fit than Major Depressive Disorder, which typically involves distinct episodes.
